meta.name: cloud-administration
meta.description: Administers the cloud the company runs on rather than the one it sells — tenant and subscription structure, the SaaS estate and who owns each app, identity as the real perimeter, cloud spend that arrives as a surprise, and what the provider does not do for you. Use this to structure subscriptions or tenants, get control of sprawling SaaS, cut a cloud bill, work out who owns an application nobody admits to buying, or decide what corporate workloads belong in cloud at all.

copy.tagline: 理清云账号与订阅结构，管好SaaS归属，压降云成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们公司云账号和SaaS应用杂乱，账单常常超预期。
copy.tagline_en: Take control of messy cloud accounts, SaaS ownership, and surprise bills.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your company's cloud accounts and SaaS apps are messy and bills keep exceeding forecasts.

howto.what: Claude 会像一位云管理员那样，帮你梳理公司云上的订阅和租户结构，标记每个应用的所有者和成本中心，并给出身份与访问控制的建议；还能分析云账单，找出浪费点并给出削减办法。
howto.when: 当用户提出要整理云订阅/租户、控制公司使用的SaaS应用、削减云支出等云管理需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我按部门梳理一下云订阅，加上负责人标签。
say.note: 生成订阅/租户结构建议。

say.text: 找出公司里所有SaaS应用，分别归谁使用、谁负责。
say.note: 通过财务和身份日志盘点应用。

say.text: 云账单又超了，分析一下哪些资源在烧钱。
say.note: 给出支出大头和削减建议。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a cloud administrator, helping you structure subscriptions and tenants, tag resources with owner/cost center, review identity and access, and analyze cloud bills to find waste.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to organize cloud subscriptions/tenants, get control over SaaS apps, cut cloud spend, or find who owns an application.

say_en.text: Help me organize our cloud subscriptions by department with owner tags.
Find all SaaS apps we use and who owns or is responsible for each.
say_en.note: Discovers apps via financial and identity logs.

say_en.text: Our cloud bill is over budget. Analyze what is driving costs.
say_en.note: Shows top cost drivers and savings ideas.
